Ledx.metaDescription: Premium professional LEDX luminaires for zoos, large-scale breeding facilities, tropical pavilions, exhibits and greenhouses. Exclusive distributor for the Czech Republic, supplied to order.
Ledx.heroTitle: Lighting for those who take light seriously.
Ledx.heroSub: Premium LEDX luminaires for zoos, large-scale breeding facilities, tropical pavilions, exhibits and greenhouses. High CRI, up to 480 W per module, IP65/66. Supplied to order.
Ledx.exclusive: Exclusive LEDX distributor for the Czech Republic
Ledx.whyLead: Not an off-the-shelf luminaire. <hl>A solution designed around your project</hl> — colour temperature, beam angle and output tailored to the space.
Ledx.whyText: We are the exclusive LEDX distributor for the Czech Republic. Luminaires are supplied to order — we'll help you choose the output, colour temperature and beam angle and prepare a quote tailored to your space.
Ledx.refsSub: You'll find LEDX luminaires in professional breeding facilities, zoo exhibits and other demanding environments.
Ledx.ctaTitle: We'll help you choose and prepare a quote.
Ledx.ctaText: As the exclusive LEDX distributor for the Czech Republic, we supply luminaires to order. Choose a range and fill in a short inquiry — we'll recommend the right output and colour temperature and prepare a quote. No obligation.
Ledx.orderBadge: Made to order · exclusive import for the Czech Republic
Ledx.inquirySub: Luminaires are supplied to order — choose a configuration and we'll prepare a tailored quote. We'll get back to you within 2 business days.
